resources.name: GeographicAddressValidation
resources.description: This resource is used to manage address validation request and response

fields.name: provideAlternative
fields.description: Indicator provided by the requester to specify if alternate addresses must be provided in case of partial or fail result.

fields.name: validationDate
fields.description: Date when the address validation is performed

fields.name: validationResult
fields.description: Result of the address validation (success, partial, fails)

fields.name: state
fields.description: Possible values for the state of a task

resourceRefs.name: submittedGeographicAddress
resourceRefs.description: the address as submitted to validation

resourceRefs.name: validGeographicAddress
resourceRefs.description: the correct form of the validated address in case of validation success

subResources.description:
Structured textual way of describing how to find a Property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently).
Note : Address corresponds to SID UrbanPropertyAddress

fields.name: city
fields.description: City that the address is in

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country that the address is in

fields.name: locality
fields.description: An area of defined or undefined boundaries within a local authority or other legislatively defined area, usually rural or semi rural in nature. [ANZLIC-STREET], or a suburb, a bounded locality within a city, town or shire principally of urban character [ANZLICSTREET]

fields.name: name
fields.description: A user-friendly name for the place, such as [Paris Store], [London Store], [Main Home]

fields.name: postcode
fields.description: descriptor for a postal delivery area, used to speed and simplify the delivery of mail (also know as zipcode)

fields.name: stateOrProvince
fields.description: the State or Province that the address is in

fields.name: streetName
fields.description: Name of the street or other street type

fields.name: streetNr
fields.description: Number identifying a specific property on a public street. It may be combined with streetNrLast for ranged addresses

fields.name: streetNrLast
fields.description: Last number in a range of street numbers allocated to a property

fields.name: streetNrLastSuffix
fields.description: Last street number suffix for a ranged address

fields.name: streetNrSuffix
fields.description: the first street number suffix

fields.name: streetSuffix
fields.description: A modifier denoting a relative direction

fields.name: streetType
fields.description: alley, avenue, boulevard, brae, crescent, drive, highway, lane, terrace, parade, place, tarn, way, wharf

children.description:
Representation of a GeographicSubAddress 
It is used for addressing within a property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). It may refer to a building, a building cluster, or a floor of a multistory building.

fields.name: buildingName
fields.description: allows for buildings that have well-known names

fields.name: levelNumber
fields.description: used where a level type may be repeated e.g. BASEMENT 1, BASEMENT 2

fields.name: levelType
fields.description: describes level types within a building

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the subAddress to identify it with a meaningful identification

fields.name: privateStreetName
fields.description: private streets internal to a property (e.g. a university) may have internal names that are not recorded by the land title office.

fields.name: privateStreetNumber
fields.description: private streets numbers internal to a private street

fields.name: subAddressType
fields.description: Type of subAddress : it can be a subunit or a private street

fields.name: subUnitNumber
fields.description:
the discriminator used for the subunit
often just a simple number e.g. FLAT 5, may also be a range

fields.name: subUnitType
fields.description:
the type of subunit
e.g.BERTH, FLAT, PIER, SUITE, SHOP, TOWER, UNIT, WHARF

params.description: Comma-separated properties to be provided in response

params.description: Requested number of resources to be provided in response

update.description: This operation updates partially a GeographicAddressValidation entity.
